name: Reshade VR Enhancer Mod (VREM)
summary: ReShade add-on that improves visual clarity in VR, with NVG and cockpit tweaks.
description: ReShade add-on for VR. Copy its `bin` and `bin-mt` folders into the DCS install directory, which adds an addon file and a `shaderreplace` folder beside DCS.exe. It needs ReShade with full add-on support. JSGME/OVGME compatible.
